title: Coefficient mate counit identity after fully faithful restriction
statement: Let C,D,E,F be categories with object predicates PC,PD,PE,PF. Let l:C→D and r:D→C be adjoint, and l′:E→F and r′:F→E be adjoint. Let tD:D→F and tC:C→E admit right adjoints sD:F→D and sC:E→C, and let e:r′⋙sC≅sD⋙r be a natural isomorphism. Assume l,r,l′,r′,tD,tC preserve the respective predicates so all six functors restrict to their full subcategories. Form α:l⋙tD≅tC⋙l′ by pullIsoOfComapIso and δ:r⋙tC→tD⋙r′ by pushHomOfComapIso from these same adjunctions and e. Write L,R,L′,TD,TC for the restrictions and ε,ε′ for the restricted counits. For every K in PD, L′(δ_K)≫ε′(TD K) equals the inverse of the lifted α_(r K), followed by TD(ε(K)). The finite-to-Qbar push-counit identity is its specialization to derived coefficient and geometric adjunctions.

proof.text: Iterated mate/conjugation cancellation identifies pushHomOfComapIso with the mate of inverse pullIsoOfComapIso. Apply mateEquiv_counit. The map_restrictFullyFaithful_counit_app equation identifies the two restricted counits with their ambient counits, using the canonical liftCompιIso comparisons for full subcategories. Faithfulness of the target inclusion reflects the ambient equality. This generic lemma is proved once; both constructible edge calculations specialize it using their actual extension/restriction adjunctions and restriction/direct-image isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem lifted_push_counit
    {r : D ⥤ C} {r' : F ⥤ E} (a : l ⊣ r) (b : l' ⊣ r')
    (hr : ∀ K : PD.FullSubcategory, PC (r.obj K.obj))
    (hr' : ∀ K : PF.FullSubcategory, PE (r'.obj K.obj))
    {sD : F ⥤ D} {sC : E ⥤ C} (aExt : tD ⊣ sD) (bExt : tC ⊣ sC)
    (e : r' ⋙ sC ≅ sD ⋙ r) (K : PD.FullSubcategory) :
    let α := Adjunction.pullIsoOfComapIso aExt bExt a b e
    let δ := Adjunction.pushHomOfComapIso aExt bExt e
    let L := PD.lift (PC.ι ⋙ l) hl
    let R := PC.lift (PD.ι ⋙ r) hr
    let L' := PF.lift (PE.ι ⋙ l') hl'
    let TD := PF.lift (PD.ι ⋙ tD) htD
    let TC := PE.lift (PC.ι ⋙ tC) htC
    let i : TD.obj (L.obj (R.obj K)) ≅ L'.obj (TC.obj (R.obj K)) :=
      PF.isoMk (α.app (r.obj K.obj))
    L'.map (ObjectProperty.homMk (δ.app K.obj)) ≫
        (b.restrictFullyFaithful (ObjectProperty.fullyFaithfulι PE)
          (ObjectProperty.fullyFaithfulι PF) (PF.liftCompιIso _ hl').symm
          (PE.liftCompιIso _ hr').symm).counit.app (TD.obj K) =
      i.inv ≫ TD.map
        ((a.restrictFullyFaithful (ObjectProperty.fullyFaithfulι PC)
          (ObjectProperty.fullyFaithfulι PD) (PD.liftCompιIso _ hl).symm
          (PC.liftCompιIso _ hr).symm).counit.app K)
